Task: Text-to-Speech

Write Python code that writes synthesized speech audio to a local file or object using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))

speech = client.audio.speech.create(
    model="tts-1",
    voice="alloy",
    input="Hello, world! This is a test of OpenAI's TTS API."
)

speech.stream_to_file("output.mp3")
```
